title: fix(types)!: a filter-builder `value` takes a group only, and `defaultValue` is retired (objectui#10825)
body:
Fixes #10825
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). An authorable key of `FilterBuilderSchema` stops accepting a bare condition, and `defaultValue` may retire. That makes this `minor` + a BREAKING (authoring) banner, and never `major`. `needs:contract-review` is applied.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (claim comment 5859442329, triage 5858920181), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's). Branch `claude/issue-10825-filter-builder-value-group-only`, cut from `origin/main` `256b4c9ef5` (BASE); head `a575be8db9`.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`: `FilterBuilderSchema.value` was `union([condition, group])`. It is now `FilterBuilderValueSchema`, in the shape `FilterGroupEntrySchema` uses for a nested sub-group (objectui#9306): `z.any().superRefine(…).pipe(FilterGroupSchema)`. A value that carries a condition's own `field` or `operator` and no `conditions` gets ONE `custom` issue at `value`, whose message is `BARE_CONDITION_VALUE_REFUSED` ("… Wrap it in `{ logic, conditions: [ … ] }` …"). The pipe stops there, so the author reads the prescription rather than a missing `logic` and `conditions`. The same string is the `.describe()` of `value`. Every other value is judged by `FilterGroupSchema` alone.
- Same file: `defaultValue` is `retirementTombstone(…)`, whose message names `value`.
- `packages/types/src/complex.ts`: `defaultValue?: never`, with a REFUSED BY NAME docblock (the `allowGroups` / `maxDepth` convention). `value?: FilterGroup` is unchanged; its docblock now says the mirror follows it.
- The renderer and `FilterBuilder` are untouched: the registration still passes `schema.value || props.value`.
- Tests: one new pin file, plus fixture triage in four existing files (below).
- Changesets: new `.changeset/10825-filter-builder-value-group-only.md` (`'@object-ui/types': minor`, a BREAKING (authoring) banner, the Clause-② line). Dated notes on two pending entries whose sentences this makes false (Acceptance notes).

## H1: a bare condition validates on main, and renders as an empty builder

A one-off probe vitest file drove the real `SchemaRenderer` over the `@object-ui/components` registry, plus `safeValidateSchema`. It was deleted after the reading and is not committed. Node `{ type: 'filter-builder', name: 'f', fields: [{ value: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: 'number' }], … }`, at BASE `256b4c9ef5`:

| `value` | `safeValidateSchema` | render |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bare condition `{ id: 'c1', field: 'amount', operator: 'greater_than', value: 100 }` | `{"success":true,"issues":[]}` | 10 elements, 0 condition rows, no input, text `WhereAdd filter`, sha256 `a9ef27d7f895b3b3…` |
| CONTROL: the same condition in `{ id: 'root', logic: 'and', conditions: [ … ] }` | success | 36 elements, 1 row, input `number=100`, text `WhereClear allAmountGreater thanRemove conditionAdd filter`, sha256 `409a3bd5189c8097…` |
| CONTROL: no filter key | success | 10 elements, 0 rows, sha256 `a9ef27d7f895b3b3…` |

The bare-condition render is byte-identical to the no-key render: the `isValidGroup` fallback to `EMPTY_GROUP`, now measured rather than read from source. At head, the bare condition returns `success: false` with ONE `custom` issue at `value`, while the group control still validates. Render readings do not move, because the renderer is untouched.

## H2: `defaultValue` has no reader, so it is retired

Runtime reading, from the same probe at BASE. A source zero cannot answer this, because `SchemaRenderer` spreads leftover node keys as props:

- `defaultValue`: a group, with no `value`: validates; render is 10 elements, 0 rows, sha256 `a9ef27d7f895b3b3…`, identical to the no-key control.
- `defaultValue`: a bare condition: validates, and renders identically again.
- Positive control that the probe sees the key it varies: the same group as `value` renders 36 elements and 1 row.

Source census, each hit quoted:

- The renderer (`renderers/complex/filter-builder.tsx`) has 0 `defaultValue` hits. It passes `value={schema.value || props.value}` and then `{...props}`.
- `FilterBuilder` (`custom/filter-builder.tsx`) has 0 hits. It destructures `fields, value, onChange, className, showClearAll, extraOperators` and has no rest spread, so a `defaultValue` arriving through `{...props}` is dropped.
- App-shell designer `widgets.tsx`: `FilterBuilderWidget` reads the SchemaForm field's `value`. The file's `defaultValue` identifier is `const defaultValue = num('default')` in the number widget, a JSON-Schema `default` and not this node's key.
- `config-field-renderer.tsx`: `const effectiveValue = value ?? field.defaultValue` is a `ConfigField`'s own key feeding `FilterBuilder`'s `value`, not a `filter-builder` node key.
- CLI `known-schema-types.ts` lists the type name `'filter-builder'` only, and no keys.
- The docs page, the components `FilterBuilder.md`, `examples/**` and `skills/**` have 0 hits.

Route taken: retirement under ADR-0049, not narrowing. The TypeScript face gets a `?: never` tombstone and the zod twin gets `retirementTombstone(…)`, both naming `value`.

## H3: producers census, where nothing needs correcting

- `examples/schema-catalog` filter-builder entries: `empty-filter-builder`, `product-search`, `search-interface` (nested in a `stack`), `user-filters`, `with-conditions`. All five author a group `value` with `logic: and` (0 / 3 / 2 / 0 / 2 rows), and none authors `defaultValue`.
- `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` declares `value?: FilterGroup; // Initial/controlled filter value`. It has no `defaultValue` and no bare condition, and its examples are the catalog entries above.
- `packages/components/docs/FilterBuilder.md` authors group `value`s only.
- `skills/**` has no filter-builder mention.
- The other faces agree. `registry.ts` maps `'filter-builder'` to `FilterBuilderSchema` by reference. `known-schema-types` lists the type only. The registration `inputs` declare `value` ("FilterGroup object with conditions") and not `defaultValue`.

No authored document changes verdict, so there is no before/after to quote.

## Pins, red on base and green on head; ablation

`packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-value-group-only-10825.test.ts`:

- (a) Four bare-condition shapes (complete, id-less, value-less, missing `field`) each get ONE `custom` issue at `value`, at `safeValidateSchema` and on the mirror. The message contains "Wrap it in `{ logic, conditions: [ … ] }`" and is contained in `value`'s published description.
- (b) With the union gone, an id-less row inside a group `value` is reported as `invalid_type` at `value.conditions.0.id`. It used to be one `invalid_union` at `value`.
- (c) LIT CONTROL: a group `value` (and an empty group, an `or` group, no key) is accepted and parses to itself. A malformed group (`{ conditions: [] }`, a query-style `{ status: 'active' }`, a string) is judged by the group schema, never by the named refusal.
- (d) `defaultValue` holding a group, a bare condition or an empty group gets ONE `invalid_type` issue at `defaultValue`. The message equals the describe text and names `value`, and the key stays declared.
- (e) Type level, judged by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: `Expect OF (Equal OF (FilterBuilderSchema['defaultValue'], undefined))`, `value` equals `FilterGroup | undefined`, an Equal-can-fail control, and a `@ts-expect-error` on an authored `defaultValue`. CONTROL: a bare condition as `value` was already a TS error. (OF stands in for angle brackets, which the body sanitizer eats.) `--listFiles` shows the file in that program (count 1).

Fixture triage (the rule's consumers, not only the edited package):

- `filter-builder-nested-group-retired-9306.test.ts`: the `defaultValue` row leaves the sub-group table, because the key is retired and now refused at the key itself.
- `filter-builder-condition-id-8415.test.ts`: the bare `doc(NO_ID)` and `defaultValue` fixtures are removed. They pinned the deleted union arm and would stay red for a reason that is not `id`. The group-row path stays.
- `filter-operator-protocol-set-9559.test.ts`: `toContain('value')` read the union's envelope. It is now `toEqual(['value.conditions.0.operator'])`, which is red on base.
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: `complex.zod.ts#FilterBuilderConditionSchema` leaves `RECURSION_BREAKING_MIRRORS`. The runtime walk reached it only through `value`'s union, and now reaches it only through `FilterGroupSchema`'s getter, which the walk does not enter. "No dead entries" went red until the row was removed. The live guidance becomes "Seven of the nine / remaining two / tenth", with a record clause naming objectui#10825. The unused import is dropped.

The red leg put both sources at BASE under the committed tests, with an absolute-path trap restore. On disk, the marker counts were `BARE_CONDITION_VALUE_REFUSED` = 0 and `defaultValue?: never` = 0. After the run, both blobs equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

- vitest over the new file, 9306, 8415, 9559 and parity: `Tests  12 failed | 79 passed (91)`. The failures are the 10 refusal and path rows of the new file, the 9559 path pin, and parity's "every recursion-breaking mirror in the region is named or recorded". All controls passed.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2: `TS2344` on `assertionDefaultValueRetired`, and `TS2578 Unused '@ts-expect-error'` on the authored-`defaultValue` literal.

The ablation reverted only the zod arm: `complex.zod.ts` at BASE, the TS face at head, on-disk counts 0 / 1, same restore proof. Result: `Tests  12 failed | 79 passed (91)`, the same 12 rows. Only the refusal rows redden, plus the two rows that follow the union's removal. Every control stays green.

Reverse type check through the built `.d.ts`: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` (VERDICT command-exit 0). The rebuilt `dist/complex.d.ts` carries `defaultValue?: never`. A scratch program under `packages/components` resolved `'@object-ui/types'` to `packages/types/dist/index.d.ts` (`--traceResolution`). An authored `defaultValue` then fails with `TS2322 … is not assignable to type 'undefined'` (exit 2), and the same literal with only `value` compiles (exit 0). The scratch was removed. The tree-scoped absence reading for the retired key: the only TS consumer of `FilterBuilderSchema` outside `packages/types` is the renderer, with 0 `defaultValue` reads.

## Gates (head `a575be8db9`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Root-form vitest over `packages/types/`, the four `examples/schema-catalog` filter-builder / corpus files and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: `Test Files  256 passed (256)`, `Tests  5503 passed (5503)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- eslint, narrowed to the 7 changed `.ts` files: 7 files in the `--format json` report, 0 errors, 11 warnings. Those are all `no-explicit-any` in `complex.ts` (9) and `complex.zod.ts` (2), equal to BASE's counts for the same two files (9 / 2). The population is read from `eslint.config.js` (`files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`). Invariance: `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 (1 changeset added). `check-changeset-no-major` ✅. `check-changeset-fixed` ✅.
- `check-changeset-overwrite` exit 0, report-only. It lists the two deliberate dated-note edits (`7760-…`, `8415-…`), whose declarations are unchanged.
- `check-changeset-claims` exit 0, report-only. It lists 27 pending changesets naming a touched file. Each was read, and see Acceptance notes.
- `check-pending-changeset-literals` ✅. `check-control-bytes` OK. `check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `check-type-check-coverage` ✅ (43/43 packages compile their tests). `check-test-path-roots` OK.
- `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only, no filter-builder row), `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:prompt-keys`: all exit 0.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over all changed paths says NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` (they compile against a built dist closure that CI's workflow builds; the filter-builder docs schema block is a `plaintext` fence), other packages' suites, and the repo-wide lint.

## Serial

`git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against a freshly fetched `origin/main` `c5ec15cabd` exits 0 with a clean tree. None of the commits `main` gained since BASE touch the edited files.

## Acceptance notes

- Pending changesets read against this diff:
  - `8415-filter-builder-condition-id.md`: two sentences became false. The document-level result is no longer an `invalid_union` at `["value"]`, and a `defaultValue` literal now fails as a retired key, not for the missing `id`. A dated note was added in the objectui#10533 form. Frontmatter md5 is `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6` before and after; file md5 went from `9e6bed51364ddada97777a9d47a9b83b` to `04ea3d39a03f4dc60a979cebfa4d4ee5`.
  - `7760-lazy-mirror-input-type-args.md`: "Those three … stay in the excluded region the parity ledger bounds at runtime" is no longer true of `FilterBuilderConditionSchema`, so it gets a dated note. Frontmatter md5 is `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6` before and after; file md5 went from `2e362fbe01cc7b1703435103b522f0e2` to `88d638a9b7ecba99bd3f40ac0a567324`.
  - Still true, left alone: `9306-filter-builder-nested-groups-retired.md` (its path `value.conditions.N` holds), `9306-filter-builder-name-authority.md`, `6939-filter-builder-mirror.md`, `10478-filter-condition-value-protocol-rule.md`, `9559-filter-operator-schema-protocol-set.md`, and the rest of the 27 the claims gate listed (none states the value union, the `defaultValue` key, or the recursion-breaking list).
- The docs page is not edited. It never declared `defaultValue` and authors no bare condition, so the order's H3 condition for touching it did not fire.
- A one-time reading, not re-derived: stored tenant metadata was not measured. A bare-condition `value` there draws an empty builder today and is refused on its next validation. The changeset says so.
- Prose drift noticed, not filed: `EXCLUSIONS['complex.zod.ts#FilterBuilderConditionSchema']` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` still opens "recursive;", while its sibling `FilterGroupSchema` entry was updated to "No longer recursive since objectui#9306". This PR does not move it.
- The PR title scope is `types`, not the order's `core`. The diff touches `@object-ui/types` only.
